chunks_lengths.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α), ∀ c ∈ (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1, c.length = n

chunks_tail_bound.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α), (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2.length < n

chunks_reconstruct.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α), (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1.flatten ++ (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n hn xs).2 = xs

chunks_rule.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (s : Aeneas.Std.Slice α) (n : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (hn : 0 < n.val), Aeneas.Std.core.slice.Slice.chunks_exact s n ⦃ it => it.chunks.map Aeneas.Std.Slice.val = (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n.val hn s.val).1 ∧ it.remainder.val = (Aeneas.Std.List.toChunksExact n.val hn s.val).2 ∧ (∀ c ∈ it.chunks, c.length = n.val) ∧ it.remainder.length < n.val ∧ (it.chunks.map Aeneas.Std.Slice.val).flatten ++ it.remainder.val = s.val ⦄

chunks_get_remainder.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (it : Aeneas.Std.core.slice.iter.ChunksExact α), it.getRemainder ⦃ r => r = it.remainder ⦄

inner_step.statement:
∀  (chunk remainder : Slice U8) (chunks : List (Slice U8))
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hc : 4 ≤ chunk.length)
     (ha : ∀ i : Fin 4, AdlerSpec.lane a i + chunk.val[i.val]!.val ≤ U32.max)
     (hb : ∀ i : Fin 4, AdlerSpec.lane b i + (AdlerSpec.lane a i + chunk.val[i.val]!.val) ≤ U32.max),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0.body ⟨chunk :: chunks, remainder⟩ a b ⦃ r =>
       ∃ av bv, r = ControlFlow.cont (⟨chunks, remainder⟩, av, bv) ∧
       ∀ i : Fin 4,
         AdlerSpec.lane av i = AdlerSpec.lane a i + chunk.val[i.val]!.val ∧
         AdlerSpec.lane bv i = AdlerSpec.lane b i + (AdlerSpec.lane a i + chunk.val[i.val]!.val) ⦄

inner_loop.statement:
∀  (chunks : List (Slice U8)) (remainder : Slice U8)
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hs : AdlerSpec.safeLanes chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b)),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0 ⟨chunks, remainder⟩ a b ⦃ av bv =>
       (AdlerSpec.lane av, AdlerSpec.lane bv) =
         AdlerSpec.rawLanes chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b) ⦄

safe_lanes.statement:
∀  (chunks : List (Slice U8)) (k : Nat) (a b : Fin 4 → Nat)
     (hlen : k + chunks.length ≤ 5552)
     (hc : ∀ c ∈ chunks, 4 ≤ c.length)
     (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ 65520 + k * 255)
     (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 65520 + k * 65520 + 255 * (k * (k + 1) / 2)),
     AdlerSpec.safeLanes chunks a b

inner_bounded.statement:
∀  (chunks : List (Slice U8)) (remainder : Slice U8)
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hn : chunks.length ≤ 5552)
     (hc : ∀ c ∈ chunks, 4 ≤ c.length)
     (ha : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane a i ≤ 65520)
     (hb : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane b i ≤ 65520),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0 ⟨chunks, remainder⟩ a b ⦃ av bv =>
       (AdlerSpec.lane av, AdlerSpec.lane bv) =
         AdlerSpec.rawLanes chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b) ⦄

remainder_bounded.statement:
∀  (chunks : List (Slice U8)) (remainder : Slice U8)
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hn : chunks.length ≤ 5552)
     (hc : ∀ c ∈ chunks, 4 ≤ c.length)
     (ha : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane a i ≤ 65520)
     (hb : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane b i ≤ 65520),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop1 ⟨chunks, remainder⟩ a b ⦃ av bv =>
       (AdlerSpec.lane av, AdlerSpec.lane bv) =
         AdlerSpec.rawLanes chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b) ⦄

chunks_count.statement:
∀  {α : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (xs : List α),
     (List.toChunksExact n hn xs).1.length * n ≤ xs.length

inner_iter.statement:
∀  (iter : core.slice.iter.ChunksExact U8)
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hn : iter.chunks.length ≤ 5552)
     (hc : ∀ c ∈ iter.chunks, 4 ≤ c.length)
     (ha : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane a i ≤ 65520)
     (hb : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane b i ≤ 65520),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop0_loop0 iter a b ⦃ av bv =>
       (AdlerSpec.lane av, AdlerSpec.lane bv) =
         AdlerSpec.rawLanes iter.chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b) ⦄

remainder_iter.statement:
∀  (iter : core.slice.iter.ChunksExact U8)
     (a b : algo.U32X4) (hn : iter.chunks.length ≤ 5552)
     (hc : ∀ c ∈ iter.chunks, 4 ≤ c.length)
     (ha : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane a i ≤ 65520)
     (hb : ∀ i, AdlerSpec.lane b i ≤ 65520),
     algo.Adler32.compute_loop1 iter a b ⦃ av bv =>
       (AdlerSpec.lane av, AdlerSpec.lane bv) =
         AdlerSpec.rawLanes iter.chunks (AdlerSpec.lane a) (AdlerSpec.lane b) ⦄
